name: Claude Code v2.1.332 — Skills from MCP Servers (Beta)
hook: Anthropic shipped v2.1.332 today, adding Skills from MCP servers in beta — MCP servers now push skills directly into Claude Code's `/` slash menu as `server:skill` entries, no manual installs needed. A new `PreSkillShellCommand` hook lets admins gate inline shell commands a skill tries to execute. The `sonnet` alias on GCP and Foundry now resolves to Sonnet 5.5; Foundry's default model also moves to Sonnet 5.5.

name: Claude Code v2.1.330 — easel Charts + 30-Day Loops
hook: v2.1.330 (Nov 20) shipped `easel`, a built-in mod on Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise that automatically draws interactive charts in macOS and Linux sessions — toggle it off in `/config`. The same release extended recurring `/loop` and scheduled task runs from 7 to 30 days, and added Enterprise sign-in via Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console.
install: Update Claude Code; toggle automatic charts off via `/config`

name: BeagleLathe — MCP Server That Collapses Tool Call Round-Trips
hook: BeagleLathe is a local MCP server for Claude Code with 11 tools that collapse common 3-5 round-trip sequences into a single call. The maker's 9-fixture benchmark reports ~46% fewer tool calls, ~10% lower cost, and ~29% faster runs (same model, both sides). Free tier: 200 calls/month.

name: JuliusBrussee/caveman — Claude Speaks Caveman, Saves 65% Output Tokens
hook: Caveman is a Claude Code skill that makes the agent write terse cave-person prose (dropping filler, using fragments) while keeping code, commands, and errors verbatim intact. Creator's 10-prompt benchmark: ~65% output token reduction, 22-87% range depending on task. MIT licensed. Trending on GitHub. The `/caveman-compress` command also rewrites CLAUDE.md files for ~46% input savings.
install: claude plugin marketplace add JuliusBrussee/caveman && claude plugin install caveman@caveman

name: CocoIndex Code — AST-Aware Semantic Search MCP for Your Codebase
hook: CocoIndex Code is an open-source Tree-sitter-based MCP that indexes your repo into AST-aware chunks, embeds them incrementally, and serves results in a single tool call. Apache 2.0, latest v0.2.22. The dev who built it reported going viral with 54k views on a post about saving ~70% of codebase-lookup tokens. 'Launched this week' per Product Hunt.
install: pip install cocoindex-code && claude mcp add cocoindex-code -- ccc mcp

name: SkillsOverMCP.com — Host Any GitHub Skills Repo as an MCP Endpoint
hook: SkillsOverMCP.com turns any public GitHub repo of SKILL.md files into a live remote MCP endpoint — free, open source. Site launched November 21, 2026. With v2.1.332 shipping native MCP skills support today, any existing skills repo (mattpocock/skills, trailofbits/skills, etc.) now becomes a zero-config distributable server.
install: Add the generated endpoint via: claude mcp add --transport http <name> <skillsovermcp-url>

name: czlonkowski/n8n-skills — 14-Skill Pack for Building n8n Workflows
hook: 14 Claude Code skills plus a router skill and hooks enforcement layer for building flawless n8n workflows. At 6.1k-6.5k GitHub stars with 1k forks, it's the most-starred n8n+Claude integration in the ecosystem. Requires the companion n8n-mcp MCP server. Skills cover workflow patterns, error handling, debugging, and execution.

name: trailofbits/skills — 60+ Security Audit Skills, Now Serveable via MCP
hook: Trail of Bits' security skills collection covers static analysis, Slither smart contract review, fuzzing patterns, and audit workflows. At 6.8k-8k GitHub stars it's the most-starred security skills repo in the ecosystem. With today's v2.1.332 MCP skills support, the trailofbits endpoint on SkillsOverMCP.com now serves 60 skills natively in Claude Code's slash menu.

name: sambhav/mcp-demo — Reference Server for Skills over MCP (SEP-2640)
hook: A Python reference MCP server implementing Agent Skills over MCP with per-client negotiation, as specced in SEP-2640. Skills are served via the resources tier — now the right way to implement for Claude Code v2.1.332's native MCP skills feature. The clearest working example of the new protocol today.

name: Apple Xcode Plugin for Claude Code — Official, Ships via xcrun
hook: Apple published an official Xcode plugin to `anthropics/claude-plugins-official` on November 6, 2026 (author: Apple Inc.). The plugin runs `xcrun agent plugin path --plugin-format claude` to generate skills from the local Xcode installation, covering build, run, test, and Apple developer docs search. No downloaded files — skills are generated fresh from your installed Xcode.
install: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-official && claude plugin install xcode@claude-plugins-official

name: TraxAgent — Per-Developer AI Spend Intelligence with MCP
hook: TraxAgent monitors Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor spend per developer, fires team alerts at 50/80/100% of budget, runs 14 nightly checks plus an AI review, and ships an MCP server so agents can query their own spend. Read-only admin key — no proxy, no SDK. Free up to $100/month in API spend.
install: See README (MCP server config at traxagent.io)

name: champion-kit — Anthropic Official Champions Productivity Plugin
hook: Anthropic's official champion-kit plugin (7 skills + 1 agent) helps designated Claude Code Champions run internal hackathons and office hours, identify patterns worth sharing across teams, and produce AI maturity reports. Ships via the official claude-plugins-official marketplace.

name: claude-code-templates — Adds Skills over MCP Component (PR #1701)
hook: PR #1701 in the popular claude-code-templates repo adds a Skills over MCP component to the template registry, targeting Claude Code 2.1.331+. Ships a remote example server serving two skills with no tools surface — the most copy-paste-ready starting point for projects that want to distribute skills over MCP.

name: Mantrana — 4-Juror AI Spec Review via MCP Inside Claude Code
hook: Mantrana routes a technical brief through 4 specialist AI 'jurors' to produce a reviewed, phased spec document. This week the team shipped MCP support, letting Claude Code users invoke the spec council directly from the terminal. Useful for teams wanting adversarial review before implementation.
install: claude mcp add --transport http mantrana https://mantrana.co/mcp
